zdroj: Dysgu Cymraeg Canolradd (De), Uned 20, s. 261–263 (slovník zpráv: Argyfyngau, Trosedd, Chwaraeon, Tywydd)

karty.priklad: Roedd damwain ddifrifol mewn ffatri yn Abertawe y bore 'ma.
karty.priklad_cs: There was a serious accident in a factory in Swansea this morning (difrifol → [dd]ifrifol after the feminine damwain).
karty.mnemo: A runaway WAIN (wagon) smashes into a DAM and bursts into flames like red lava: DAM-WAIN.

extra.pozn: after the article y ddamwain (Digwyddodd y ddamwain yn gynnar y bore 'ma, p. 261); sentence from the Bwletin Newyddion, p. 261

karty.priklad: Daeth y tîm achub o hyd i gwch.
karty.priklad_cs: The rescue team found a boat (cwch → [g]wch after i).
karty.mnemo: bad achub = lifeboat.

extra.pozn: bad achub = lifeboat (L4); achubwr = rescuer (outside the coursebook); arbed (L3) = to save money, space; sentence from the Bwletin Newyddion, p. 261

karty.priklad: Aethpwyd â saith o blant i'r ysbyty.
karty.priklad_cs: Seven children were taken to hospital (plant → [b]lant after o).
karty.mnemo: aeth (went) + -pwyd (impersonal): 'there was a going with' = was taken.

extra.pozn: impersonal past of mynd â (to take), news only; colloquially Aeth saith o blant i'r ysbyty; â becomes ag before a vowel; sentence from the Bwletin Newyddion, p. 261

karty.priklad: Aethpwyd â'r dringwr i'r ysbyty mewn ambiwlans awyr.
karty.priklad_cs: The climber was taken to hospital by air ambulance.
karty.mnemo: ambiwlans + awyr (air, L4): an air ambulance landing on a snowy mountainside.

extra.pozn: the book gives neither gender nor plural; ambiwlans is usually masculine, plural ambiwlansys (outside the coursebook); own example

karty.priklad: Mae dau gerddwr ar goll ar y mynydd.
karty.priklad_cs: Two walkers are missing on the mountain (cerddwr → [g]erddwr after dau).
karty.mnemo: colli = to lose: ar goll = lost.

extra.pozn: coll → goll after ar; colli = to lose, colled = loss (L12); colloquially also Mae fy allweddi i ar goll; own example

karty.priklad: Daeth hofrennydd i achub y dringwyr.
karty.priklad_cs: A helicopter came to rescue the climbers.
karty.mnemo: hofran (to HOVER) + -ydd: a helicopter hovering over the polar ice cap.

extra.pozn: hofran = to hover (outside the coursebook); singular with nn, plural with one n; own example

karty.priklad: Bydd y llong yn hwylio i Iwerddon yfory.
karty.priklad_cs: The ship will sail to Ireland tomorrow.
karty.mnemo: hwyl = sail and also good spirits (L10): with a good hwyl you sail well.

extra.pozn: hwyl = sail, also fun, mood (L10); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r tân wedi llosgi'r sied i gyd.
karty.priklad_cs: The fire has burnt the whole shed.
karty.mnemo: You LOSE your eyebrows (LLOS-gi) when you burn the toast.

extra.pozn: llosgfynydd = volcano (outside the coursebook); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r hen goeden wedi marw.
karty.priklad_cs: The old tree has died (coeden → [g]oeden after hen).
karty.mnemo: marwolaeth (death): marw = to die.

extra.pozn: past: bu farw (news), colloquially fuodd e farw or farwodd e (see 0848); marw is also an adjective, dead; marwolaeth = death (L3); own example

karty.priklad: Suddodd y cwch, ond cafodd pawb eu hachub.
karty.priklad_cs: The boat sank, but everyone was rescued (achub → [h]achub after eu).
karty.mnemo: SUDDO ~ SUDDenly: the boat SUDDenly goes down.

extra.pozn: own example

karty.cs_upresneni: a court case; not a cause
karty.priklad: Bydd yr achos yn Llys y Goron yr wythnos nesa.
karty.priklad_cs: The case will be at the Crown Court next week.
karty.mnemo: achos = because, cause: a court case is about the cause of it all – heard in a courtroom as cold as a freezer.

extra.pozn: achos also means cause, and colloquially because (= oherwydd, L11); achos da = good cause (L4); own example

karty.priklad: Anfonodd y barnwr y lleidr i'r carchar am ddwy flynedd.
karty.priklad_cs: The judge sent the thief to prison for two years (dwy → [dd]wy after am; blynedd → [f]lynedd after dwy).
karty.mnemo: barn (opinion) + -wr (person): a judge giving his opinion in a courtroom with icicles hanging from the ceiling.

extra.rod_pozn: grammatically masculine even for a woman
extra.pozn: barn = opinion, barnu = to judge (outside the coursebook); beirniad = adjudicator (L5); own example

karty.priklad: Mae rhywun wedi dwyn fy meic i!
karty.priklad_cs: Someone has stolen my bike! (beic → [m]eic after fy)
karty.mnemo: A thief DOING (DWYN) a runner with your bike.

extra.pozn: in literary Welsh also to bear, to bring; stem not given: literary dyg- (dygodd), the colloquial past varies; lleidr (L11), lladrad (L14); own example

karty.priklad: Cafwyd y lladron yn euog gan Lys y Goron.
karty.priklad_cs: The thieves were found guilty by the Crown Court (Llys → [L]ys after gan).
karty.mnemo: llys (court, L7) + coron (crown): the court sits under a crown of frost.

extra.pozn: coron (f) → goron after y; cafwyd … yn euog = was / were found guilty, impersonal form; plural outside the coursebook; sentence from the Bwletin Newyddion, p. 261

karty.priklad: Daethpwyd o hyd i gar yn yr afon.
karty.priklad_cs: A car was found in the river (car → [g]ar after i).

extra.pozn: impersonal past of dod o hyd i (to find, L8), news only; colloquially Daeth rhywun o hyd i gar; sentence from the Bwletin Newyddion, p. 261

karty.priklad: Bydd dau ddyn yn ymddangos o flaen llys ynadon Abertawe yfory.
karty.priklad_cs: Two men will appear before Swansea magistrates' court tomorrow (dyn → [dd]yn after dau).
karty.mnemo: llys (court) + ynadon (magistrates): three magistrates in blue scarves in an unheated courtroom.

extra.pozn: ynad (pl. ynadon) = magistrate, justice of the peace (outside the coursebook); ymddangos o flaen y llys = to appear before the court (p. 261); plural outside the coursebook; sentence based on p. 261

karty.priklad: Sgoriodd Cymru gais yn yr ail hanner.
karty.priklad_cs: Wales scored a try in the second half (cais → [g]ais as the object).
karty.mnemo: ceisio = to try: a rugby try is literally a 'try' – scored in the sleet on a frozen pitch.

extra.pozn: plural ceisiau = tries, attempts; ceisiadau = applications; ceisio = to try; ffurflen gais = application form (L3); own example

karty.priklad: Roedd hi'n ddi-sgôr ar yr egwyl.
karty.priklad_cs: It was goalless at half time (di-sgôr → [dd]i-sgôr after yn).
karty.mnemo: di- (without) + sgôr (score).

extra.pozn: the prefix di- = without, as in di-Gymraeg (L16); sentence from the Bwletin Newyddion, p. 261

karty.priklad: Enillodd Wrecsam o dair gôl i ddwy.
karty.priklad_cs: Wrexham won by three goals to two (tair, dwy = feminine forms of the numbers; dwy → [dd]wy after i).
karty.mnemo: GOAL (GÔL): the keeper's gloves are smouldering red after that shot.

extra.pozn: feminine gender confirmed by tair gôl (p. 261); sentence from the Bwletin Newyddion, p. 261

karty.priklad: Mae Cymru wedi cyrraedd y rownd gyn-derfynol!
karty.priklad_cs: Wales have reached the semi-final!
karty.mnemo: cyn (before) + terfynol (final): the round before the final, red flares blazing in the stands.

extra.pozn: cyn-derfynol → gyn-derfynol after the feminine rownd; no mutation in the plural; plural outside the coursebook; own example

karty.priklad: Collodd Abertawe yn y rownd derfynol.
karty.priklad_cs: Swansea lost in the final.
karty.mnemo: terfyn (end): the last round, a trophy so red-hot nobody can hold it.

extra.pozn: terfynol → derfynol after the feminine rownd; no mutation in the plural; plural outside the coursebook; own example

karty.priklad: Bydd cenllysg a mellt mewn sawl ardal heno.
karty.priklad_cs: There will be hail and lightning in several areas tonight.
karty.mnemo: KEN LISPS (CEN-LLYSG) through chattering teeth, pelted by hail.

extra.pozn: collective noun, gender not given; the book gives cenllysg/cesair as equals, cesair is perhaps rather northern (to be checked); mellt (L5), taran (L14); own example

karty.priklad: Mae'r gwynt yn chwythu'n gryf heddiw.
karty.priklad_cs: The wind is blowing hard today (cryf → [g]ryf after yn).
karty.mnemo: WHOOTH! (CHWYTH-u) – the sound of blowing out candles.

extra.pozn: own example

karty.priklad: Bydd hi'n braf ledled Cymru.
karty.priklad_cs: It will be fine all over Wales.
karty.mnemo: lled = width: ledled = across the whole width.

extra.pozn: ledled y wlad = throughout the country; ar draws (Cymru) = across (p. 261); sentence from the Bwletin Newyddion, p. 261

karty.priklad: Bydd hi'n fwyn heddiw, ond yn wlyb.
karty.priklad_cs: It will be mild today, but wet (mwyn → [f]wyn, gwlyb → [w]lyb after yn).
karty.mnemo: A MOOing (MWYN) cow in a mild, gentle meadow.

extra.pozn: homonyms: mwyn (noun) = ore, er mwyn = for the sake of, in order to; own example
